en-US.author: Jens Roggenfelder
en-US.description: Cloud-free revival for Bose SoundTouch speakers. Unofficial community project, not affiliated with Bose.
en-US.longDescription:
ST Reborn (STR) brings internet radio, Spotify Connect, the hardware preset keys and multiroom back to Bose SoundTouch speakers after the Bose cloud shutdown. The desktop app installs a small agent onto the speaker over your home network and then controls every speaker running STR, with no Bose cloud and no account.
STR is an independent open source project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Bose Corporation. Bose and SoundTouch are registered trademarks of Bose Corporation.

en-US.releaseNotes:
STR v1.5.2
Built from commit: ad82820dcab319d9691080399f78f4f6cae5ee97
Workflow run: https://github.com/JRpersonal/streborn/actions/runs/41925893357
What's changed in v1.5.2
New features
- Per-speaker volume buttons in a group, and the group's speakers on the Play tab (remote)
Fixes
- A Recently played card without song rows, such as a single file from the Library, now shows when it played (app)
- Saving a Spotify key right after switching accounts no longer says the plan could not be checked (app)
- Two playlists played from the same preset key now get their own Recently played cards (library)
- Speakers that cannot be reached are not offered for a group, failures say so in plain words, and no old error flashes up before a group forms (multiroom)
- Pausing and resuming a music file of unknown length no longer stops it about 20 seconds later (playback)
- Play after Pause on a music file no longer jumps back to the pause point (playback)
- "Update all speakers" on the phone now ends with "try again when your network is back" during a network outage instead of waiting for hours (remote)
- The phone remote lights the Bluetooth or AUX button also when the input was chosen in the app (remote)
- The firmware guide no longer writes an older firmware to the stick, and the install waits for a speaker that is still starting up (setup)

Verify your download
Every binary in this release is attested by GitHub's build provenance system.
# SHA256 checksum
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
# Sigstore attestation (requires GitHub CLI)
gh attestation verify STR-Windows.exe --owner JRpersonal
Code signing
Windows: signed with a Certum Open Source code signing certificate. SmartScreen may still warn while the signature builds download reputation.
macOS: signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple. The app and the disk image each carry a stapled ticket, so Gatekeeper opens them without a warning, offline included.
Any warning you do see, and the exact click path past it, is documented on the website Verify page.
VirusTotal scan
